title: WAMTA per-year site config (config.yml)
description: Per-year metadata, branding, slideshow, and social-media links. Surfaced site-wide via _config.yml's data lookups (e.g. site.data.years.<year>.config).

full_title.description: Long workshop title (e.g. 'Workshop on Asynchronous Many-Task Systems and Applications 2026').

short_title.description: Short workshop title used in the navbar / browser tab (e.g. 'WAMTA 26').

email.description: Primary contact email for the year. Use 'TBA' for placeholder years.

description.description: One-line description used in <meta> tags and the contact card. 'TBA' is acceptable for placeholder years.

location.description: Human-readable location (e.g. 'Garching near Munich, Germany'). 'TBA' is acceptable for placeholder years.

date.description: Free-form date range (e.g. 'February 16th to 18th, 2026'). 'TBA' is acceptable for placeholder years.

logo_path.description: Site-relative path to the year's logo, expected under /assets/years/<year>/images/.

important_dates_card_suffix.description: Optional suffix appended to the Important Dates card title (e.g. '(AoE)').

slideshow.description: Ordered list of slideshow images displayed on the home page. Empty array suppresses the slideshow.

image_path.description: Site-relative path to the slide image, expected under /assets/years/<year>/images/slideshow/.

active.description: When true, marks the slide as the initially-active one in a Bootstrap carousel.

socialMedia.description: Optional social media links. Empty / null entries hide the corresponding icon.
